confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak tourist season and rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor using typical local price ratios (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX rate comes from a search-result summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Andean tourist city. Restaurant and cafe prices are benchmarked to non-capital regional cities and set below capital-city levels. Hotel and hostel prices are set below Cusco's tourist-facing rates, which are typically higher.
